summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_thread_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in run_async. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 11 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH=src. Nothing committed. Full suite: 68 failures, identical to the pristine HEAD baseline (missing pytest-asyncio in the venv); tests/cli and tests/devtools could not be collected (missing click and aiohttp). The venv's editable textual install points at a different checkout, so tests were run with PYTHONPATH=src.
